sources.title: AmrutiyaKirtan/NumPy-MLP-Engine - GitHub
sources.snippet: A professional-grade implementation of a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) built entirely from scratch using only NumPy. This project demonstrates the core mechanics of Deep Learning, from matrix calculus to advanced optimization strategies, achieving state-of-the-art results on the MNIST dataset without the help of high-level frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
